links.outcome: Model safety under adversarial jailbreak conversations, commercial versus medical-specialized models
links.effect: Commercial models maintained robust safety; medical-specialized models showed increased vulnerability, which persisted across Japanese and English versions.
links.quote: we find that commercial models maintain robust safety while medical-specialized models exhibit increased vulnerability.

links.outcome: Safety score change across turns of adversarial multi-turn conversations
links.effect: Safety scores declined significantly across conversation turns (median 9.5 to 5.0, p < 0.001).
links.quote: Furthermore, safety scores decline significantly across conversation turns (median: 9.5 to 5.0, $p < 0.001$).
